about.en: REI is the native coin of REI Network, a lightweight, EVM-compatible proof-of-stake Layer 1 blockchain with no gas fees for staked users, developed by the former GXChain team; GXC holders swapped into REI when the network launched. REI is used for staking, node voting and governance. It is not the unrelated Hyperliquid spot token or the Base AI-agent tokens that also use the REI ticker.
